function.name: edit
function.description: Replace exactly one unique text fragment in an existing UTF-8 file. old_text must match the file byte-for-byte (indentation included) and occur exactly once; include surrounding lines to disambiguate. For several fragments in one file use patch.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root.

old_text.description: Exact existing text to replace. Must occur exactly once.

new_text.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete the fragment).
